decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent industrial printer that matches the firm's hardware, ink and service strengths, it is likely to remain in the portfolio.
This software module supports digital variable-data printing and traceability while requiring relatively limited resources compared with a new hardware platform.
Although the mobile app is less central than the firm's coding equipment, it still fits the push toward serialization and traceability and is worth retaining if it supports customer workflows.
An inline code verification system is highly complementary to the firm's marking business and strengthens its one-stop compliance and quality offering.
Print layout design software reinforces common operation across systems and helps bind customers more closely to the firm's broader coding portfolio.
